rationale: Reviewed all 105 registered300 Y451-555 planes and six representative X/Z contact sheets (18 displayed planes, X351-353 repeated). Candidates track the superior and lateral cavity rim, narrow inferior extension and tapering anterior termination. Adjacent gray nuclear tissue and tissue separating external sulci remain outside the candidate fill. Original cavity narrows at Y550-551 and closes in subsequent planes. Majority support is a locator rule, not anatomical proof; no mirrored left-side labels or existing nonzero labels are overwritten.
limitation: AI image review, not expert review or complete ventricular segmentation. Representative X/Z checks, no additional native100 review. Medial crop continuation and other ventricular omissions remain unresolved. Integration verification recorded separately; not public deployment.
